entities.name: Nnr NAD(P)HX repair enzyme
observations: The 505-aa query protein matches reviewed Nnr homologs at 33.2–35.9% identity with 99% query coverage.
Predicted architecture contains YjeF_N at residues 26–191 and Carb_kinase at residues 252–495.
Nnr proteins combine NAD(P)HX epimerase and ADP-dependent NAD(P)HX dehydratase activities.
Reviewed homologs annotate one bound K+ ion per subunit.

entities.name: NAD(P)HX epimerization
observations: These reactions repair both stereoisomeric forms of hydrated NAD(P)H.

entities.name: ADP-dependent NAD(P)HX dehydration
observations: For NADHX: (6S)-NADHX + ADP → NADH + AMP + phosphate + H+.
For NADPHX: (6S)-NADPHX + ADP → NADPH + AMP + phosphate + H+.
The reaction uses ADP and produces AMP and inorganic phosphate while restoring NADH or NADPH.

entities.name: NAD(P)H metabolite repair
observations: NAD(P)HX repair removes hydrated NADH/NADPH damage arising from enzymatic or heat-dependent hydration.
The associated curated GO process is metabolite repair.
